panel.name: Full name
panel.pdfFail: Could not load the Gold report.
panel.emptyBody: Moolank, Bhagyank, predictions, remedies, grids and advanced Anka tools all start from your birth date.
panel.badDate: Please enter a valid date of birth.
panel.using: Using birth details from {name}. Edit the fields above to analyse anyone else.
panel.goldTeaser: Personalised predictions, remedies and tools are built for Gold members.

core.moolankDesc: How you see yourself; governs nature, desires and early life (up to ~35).
core.bhagyankDesc: How the world sees you; governs fortune, karma and later life.
core.namankDesc: Vibration of your name; shapes reputation and day-to-day interactions.
core.harmonySub: Relationships derive from the Naisargika Maitri (natural friendship) of each number's ruling graha.
core.enemyNote: Moolank and Bhagyank rulers are natural enemies — inner desires and outer destiny pull in different directions. A name number friendly to both helps bridge the gap (see the Name tab).
core.karmicSub: Compound totals of 13, 14, 16 or 19 indicate lessons carried from past karma.
core.chartTitle: Number Rulers in Your Birth Chart
core.chartSub: A strong natal ruler amplifies the number's promise; a weak one calls for its remedies.
core.profilesSub: Complete Anka Jyotish profile for each number — select any number to explore.

grid.built: Built from your birth date digits, Moolank and Bhagyank. Zeros are ignored.
grid.builtKua: Built from your birth date digits, Moolank, Bhagyank and Kua. Zeros are ignored.
grid.vedicNote: Vedic square: Jupiter · Sun · Mars across the top, Ketu at the centre.
grid.loshuNote: Lo Shu magic square: every row, column and diagonal sums to 15.
grid.planesSub: Complete lines (all three numbers present) form a yoga; empty lines indicate an area to develop.
grid.missingSub: Absent energies and their classical remedies.
grid.allPresent: All nine numbers are present — a rare, well-rounded grid.
grid.repeatSub: Repetition intensifies a number — beneficial up to a point, then excessive.
grid.arrowsSub: Birth-date digits only, on the 3-6-9 / 2-5-8 / 1-4-7 chart. A full line is an arrow of strength; an empty line is an arrow of weakness.
grid.noArrows: No complete or empty lines — a balanced chart without strong arrows.
grid.kuaSub: Directional number from solar year {year} and gender. Face these directions while working, sleeping and meeting.
grid.kuaHint: Select male or female above to include the Kua number and its favourable directions.

name.emptySub: Enter your name above (as commonly used / signed) to calculate the Namank.
name.lettersSub: Vedic / Indian numerology uses Chaldean values — no letter carries 9, the sacred number.
name.readAs: Cheiro's table ends at 52, so {compound} is read as {readAs} (same root {root}).
name.correctSub: A name total whose root is friendly to both Moolank and Bhagyank, and whose compound is not a warning number, is considered lucky.
name.nearest: Nearest favourable totals — adjust spelling (e.g. doubling a letter or adding a vowel) by the shown amount:
name.noTargets: No nearby totals support both core numbers strongly; prioritise Moolank harmony.

depth.title: Name Depth
depth.sub: Letter intensity on the 1–9 (Pythagorean) table — Chaldean has no 9, so lessons and passions are read here.
depth.noLessons: Every number 1–9 appears in the name — no karmic lessons.
depth.spellSub: Try variants side by side (e.g. Abhishek / Abhisheik / Abhishekh). Ranked by Chaldean harmony with Moolank {m} and Bhagyank {b}.
depth.devaSub: Sanskrit Sankhya numbering (Katapayadi) of each akshara, plus the Chaldean value of the usual English spelling.
depth.devaHint: Type the name in Devanagari script to read its aksharas.
depth.kataNote: Only the last consonant of a conjunct counts; bare vowels are 0; the number reads right to left (aṅkānāṃ vāmato gatiḥ).

cycles.bandAria: Numerology life phases and pinnacles by age
cycles.universalLine: Today's universal number {day} with your Moolank {m}:
cycles.forecastSub: Personal year numbers run in 9-year cycles from birthday to birthday.
cycles.luckySub: Dates whose root number harmonises with both Moolank and Bhagyank. Use them for launches, signings and important beginnings.
cycles.powerSub: Calendar dates whose root matches your Moolank (personal power) or Bhagyank (destiny). Best for interviews, launches and rituals.

compat.partnerSub: Compare core numbers, combined grids and the relationship number for marriage, business or friendship.
compat.needDob: Enter a date of birth to see the couple analysis below.
compat.checkSub: Check if a mobile, vehicle, house or account number suits your Moolank and Bhagyank.
compat.conflict: Contains digits that conflict with your Moolank: {digits}
compat.zeros: Many zeros ({n}) weaken a mobile number's vibration in Indian numerology.
compat.matrixSub: How each number relates to every other (row ↔ column). Your Moolank and Bhagyank rows are highlighted.

predictions.maturitySub: Moolank {m} + Bhagyank {b} = {compound} → {value}. The personality that emerges after ~35.
predictions.areasSub: Based primarily on Moolank, coloured by harmony with Bhagyank.
predictions.monthSub: Personal month = personal year + calendar month, reduced. Harmony is vs your Moolank.
predictions.pinnaclesSub: Four chapters of life. First pinnacle length = 36 − Bhagyank.
predictions.challengesSub: Lessons derived from differences between day, month and year roots.
predictions.yogasSub: Classical Anka combinations from core numbers and the grid.
predictions.noYogas: No major yogas present right now — build them via name correction and missing-number remedies.

remedies.gemSub: Always prefer a tested substitute if the primary stone is expensive or requires trial (esp. Neelam, Gomed, Cat's Eye).
remedies.weekSub: Actions grouped by weekday from your focus numbers' fasting / remedy days.
remedies.actionsSub: Urgent first — work top-down. Source shows why each remedy was prescribed.
remedies.quickSub: Classical remedies for your Moolank and Bhagyank — always useful as a baseline.

tools.inclusionSub: How often each digit appears in your grid build.
tools.brandSub: Score a business name, brand word, or signature as written.
tools.monthSub: Personal day for each date — best / good / caution vs Moolank.
tools.marriageSub: Score upcoming years for both charts' personal years (2 & 6 favoured).
tools.healthSub: Body zones from Moolank, missing numbers, and challenging personal year.
tools.yantraSub: Focus numbers from your remedy package.
tools.vastuSub: Quick directional bridge — open Astro Vastu for full overlay.
tools.compareSub: Side-by-side core numbers for a second person.
tools.savesSub: Stored in browser localStorage — useful for client sessions.
tools.label: Label

baby.title: Baby Name Suggester
baby.sub: Chaldean totals that support the baby's Moolank & Bhagyank (or both parents if DOB is not yet known).

partnerTool.title: Business Partnership Matcher
partnerTool.sub: Working-style and long-term fortune scores, venture number, and suggested role split.
partnerTool.need: Enter both dates of birth to score the partnership.

business.title: Business Numerology
business.sub: Name, launch date, logo initial and GST / PAN / CIN / phone, scored for owner Moolank {m} and Bhagyank {b}.
business.name: Business / brand name
business.hint: Letters use Chaldean values; digits count at face value.
business.weights: Weighted: name ×3, date ×2, initial and registration ×1
business.finderKnown: Dates that support you and the business name (root {root}).
business.finderUnknown: Dates that support your Moolank and Bhagyank. Enter a business name to also match it.
business.none: No strongly supportive dates this month — try the next one.
business.muhurta: Confirm the final pick with the Muhurta tool for tithi, nakshatra and lagna.

dasha.title: Dasha ↔ Number Timing
dasha.needChart: Load a birth chart to map Vimshottari Mahadasha / Antardasha lords onto Anka numbers.
dasha.unlock: to unlock chart-linked dasha timing for this numerology reading.
dasha.mismatch: Dasha bridge appears when the numerology date matches your active chart's birth date ({date}). Reset the DOB above to the chart date, or ensure Vimshottari dashas are calculated.

client.label: CRM client
client.note: Saved notes use {name}'s stored birth date and gender; the name field above sets the spelling analysed.

calendar.title: Year Calendar (.ics)
calendar.sub: Personal-day ratings for every date with the sunrise tithi for {place}. Imports into Google, Apple or Outlook calendar.
calendar.locked: Calendar export is a Gold feature.
calendar.placeHint: Open a chart to use its birthplace for sunrise; tithi can change by location.
